title: Concept: Velocity template error returned to a client
description: A Velocity template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The parser error repeats the template line and the token it choked on, which is a direct view of how the page is built.
applicability: Deployments that render a Velocity template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The parser error repeats the template line and the token it choked on, which is a direct view of how the page is built.
